basis: Direct inspection of all 32 original-resolution canopy contact sheets for days 10 and 20, 5 rosemary sheets, 9 bok_choy sheets. Indices refer to the saved panel inventories, before any research split or model results.
normal_definition: Crop is supported by source identity and no conspicuous visible lesion or physical tissue loss is observed. This is healthy-appearing, not proof of pathogen absence.
raw_abnormal_definition: Conspicuous enclosed openings or missing tissue in true leaf blades, visually distinct from ordinary curly/lobed margins. Cause unknown; not assigned to black rot, downy mildew, powdery mildew or a diagnosed pest.
ambiguous_policy: Exclude uncertain colour differences, folds, natural lobing, cotyledon-only seedlings and unclear isolated marks. Do not infer a state from day, cultivar or filename.
limitations: Raw kale labels are new single-AI visual annotations, not original publisher health labels or independent plant-pathologist adjudications.
Cultivar, plant age, acquisition stage and visible tissue loss remain correlated; internal performance cannot establish pathology or field generalisation.
A/B/C share the identical evidence-reviewed list and splits. Labels are fixed before any model fitting.
Original files remain untouched. All unresolved examples and all other raw dates are excluded only in the new manifest.
